title: 第155章 见到顾承礼
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

此时顾承礼快步走到宋禾面前，表情呆愣愣的满是不可置信。

蒙星的雨丝落在脸上，让顾承礼清醒的认识到宋禾真的出现在自己面前了。

“你怎么……”怎么会突然出现在这里。

宋禾上前一步，把手里的伞盖在他头顶上，看着他的眼睛，笑着轻声道：“想你了，就来了。”

然后宋禾就眼睁睁的看着顾承礼脸颊开始泛红一直红到了脖颈，整个人都变成了红色。

宋禾看见顾承礼的反应后，顿时失笑，拿出帕子伸手帮他擦脸。

“瞧你走的那么急，伞都没顾得打，万一得风寒怎么办？在外面得照顾好自己，以后可不能这样了。”

顾承礼几乎贪婪的看着宋禾，“嗯，我保证以后不再不会了。”

“嫂子，你怎么突然来府城来。”

身后传来江霖之的声音，宋禾看过去。

顾承礼自然的接过宋禾手中的伞，伞身向宋禾身旁倾斜，他半个肩膀露在外面，然后神色自然的朝宋禾身边靠了靠，目光看向宋禾。

宋禾道：“江秀才，赵秀才。”

赵修远颔首，“宋娘子。”

江霖之笑着道：“嫂子叫我名字就行。”

宋禾笑着说：“我在府城找了个地方住，今日府学休沐二位若是有空，不妨去我家吃个便饭。”

顾承礼此时看向两位好友，目光分明在说你们别打扰我们。

赵修远嘴角一抽，转而一笑，“好啊。”

顾承礼：……

宋禾觉得请顾承礼的好朋友回家吃饭很正常，“家里已经备了些薄酒，二位千万不要嫌弃。”

江霖之完全没看出来顾承礼的嫌弃，连忙摇头，“不会不会，我们怎么会嫌弃呢。”

宋禾指向一侧，“住处距离这边不远，走一会儿就到了。”

赵修远看见顾承礼如此端方持重的人白眼都快翻到天上去了，突然“嘶”了一声。

“坏了，我忘了把文章交给秦训导了，霖之你是不是也没给。”

江霖之：“啊？”

赵修远一本正经的道：“那是那篇‘为政以德论’的文章啊。你是不是也没教。”

Page (1/3)

At this time, Gu Chengli quickly walked up to Song He, his expression blank and full of disbelief.

The misty raindrops fell on his face, making Gu Chengli realize clearly that Song He had really appeared in front of him.

"How did you..." Why did you suddenly appear here.

Song He took a step forward, covered his head with the umbrella in his hand, looked into his eyes, smiled and said softly: "I missed you, so I came here."

Then Song He watched helplessly as Gu Chengli's cheeks began to turn red all the way to his neck, and his whole body turned red.

When Song He saw Gu Chengli's reaction, he immediately laughed and took out his handkerchief to wipe his face.

"Look at you walking in such a hurry, you didn't even bother to open your umbrella. What if you get cold? You have to take care of yourself outside. You can't do this again."

Gu Chengli looked at Song He almost greedily, "Well, I promise I won't do it again in the future."

"Sister-in-law, why do you come to Fucheng suddenly?"

Jiang Linzhi's voice came from behind, and Song He looked over.

Gu Chengli naturally took the umbrella from Song He's hand and tilted the umbrella towards Song He. Half of his shoulders were exposed. Then he leaned towards Song He with a natural expression and looked at Song He.

Song He said: "Jiang Xiucai, Zhao Xiucai."

Zhao Xiuyuan nodded, "Ms. Song."

Jiang Linzhi smiled and said, "Sister-in-law, just call me by my name."

Song He said with a smile: "I found a place to live in Fucheng. If you two, Xiu Mu from Fucheng, are free today, you might as well come to my house for a casual meal."

Gu Chengli looked at his two friends at this time, his eyes clearly saying don't disturb us.

Zhao Xiuyuan twitched the corner of his mouth, then smiled, "Okay."

Gu Chengli:......

Song He thought it was normal to invite Gu Chengli's good friends home for dinner. "We have prepared some wine at home. Don't dislike it, you two."

Jiang Linzhi didn't notice Gu Chengli's dislike at all, and quickly shook his head, "No, no, no, how could we dislike it."

Song He pointed to one side and said, "The residence is not far from here. It will only take a short walk."

Zhao Xiuyuan almost rolled his eyes when he saw Gu Chengli, such a dignified and upright person, and suddenly let out a "hiss".

"It's bad, I forgot to give the article to Qin Xun, Linzhi, didn't you also give it to me?"

Jiang Linzhi: "Huh?"

Zhao Xiuyuan said seriously: "That's the article on 'Government based on ethics'. Didn't you teach it too?"
